sentences: I measure the dimensions of an A4 sheet with a ruler to confirm it is 210 by 297 millimeters.
I check the paper weight in grams per square meter before loading it into the printer tray.
I count the sheets in a new ream to verify that it contains exactly five hundred pages.
I load a stack of white copy paper into the printer's bottom tray and close the drawer.
I adjust the print margins to one inch on all sides before sending the document to the printer.
I fold a sheet of letter paper in thirds and slide it into a standard number ten envelope.
I cut a sheet of cardboard-backed paper along a straight line using a metal ruler and knife.
I staple three sheets of paper together at the top left corner with a standard stapler.
I punch two holes in the left margin of each sheet so they fit into a two-ring binder.
I write my name and the date on the top line of the lined paper with a blue ballpoint pen.
I erase a pencil mark from the paper using a white vinyl eraser until the surface is clean.
I sort the construction paper into separate piles by color: red, blue, green, and yellow.
I place old newspapers into the recycling bin after removing any plastic wrap or rubber bands.
I store loose sheets of paper in a three-ring binder with clear plastic sleeves for protection.
I test a sheet of paper for ink bleed by drawing a thick line and checking the reverse side.
I run a sheet of paper through the laminating machine to cover it with a clear plastic film.
I feed old bank statements into the cross-cut shredder until the bin is full of strips.
I place a sheet of tracing paper over a map and trace the coastline with a pencil.
I blend shredded paper with water in a blender to make pulp for handmade sheets.
I file the signed contract in a manila folder and place it in the second drawer.
